items.title: 8.4 Policies, qawaneen aur zimmedarana jiddat (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Jaise jaise emerging technologies aage barh rahi hain, in ke mehfooz aur akhlaqi istemal ke liye wazeh policies aur zimmedarana ijaad ke tareeqe zaroori hain (Figure 8.7). Qawaneen, governance frameworks (hukmrani ke dhaanche) aur mukhtalif shobon ka ishtirak tarakki aur jawabdehi mein tawazun rakhte hain. Yeh samajh kar ke policies technology ki tarakki ko kaise shakal deti hain, talaba aise hal banana seekh sakte hain jo insaf aur shamooliyat qaim rakhein aur muashre ki bhalai mein hissa dalein.

blocks.title: Do You Know?
blocks.text: AI, IoT, Cloud aur Blockchain ko mila kar rozmarra zindagi ke liye zyada smart aur kaar-amad systems banaye ja sakte hain.

blocks.alt: Ek doosre ke andar daire: bain-ul-aqwami dhaanche (bahar), qaumi policy, developers, aur darmiyan log. Saath 'working together' dabba: qanooni maahireen (qanoon ki pabandi), samajiyat ke maahireen (samaji asar), akhlaqiyat ke maahireen (akhlaqi faisle), engineers (mehfooz, chalte systems) aur users aur biradariyan (zarooratein, zabanein, rasai). Note: logon ko pehle rakhein; technology sirf munafe nahi, zindagiyan munsifana behtar kare.
blocks.caption: Figure 8.7: Policies aur akhlaqi usool zimmedarana ijaad aur technology mein users ke huqooq ki hifazat yaqeeni banate hain (kitab ki Figure 8.7 par apna khaaka).
blocks.long_description: Qawaid aik saath kai satahon se aate hain, aur un ke andar banane ke liye aik se zyada shobon ke log chahiye.

blocks.text: Artificial Intelligence (AI), Internet of Things (IoT) aur Blockchain jaisi emerging technologies insani zindagi ke kai pehluon par asar dalti hain, privacy aur rozgar se le kar faisla sazi aur hifazat tak. Munasib qawaneen aur regulations ke baghair in technologies ka ghalat istemal ho sakta hai ya yeh na-insafi wale nataij de sakti hain. Policies tay karti hain ke data kaise jama, store aur use ho, taake hifazat ho aur logon ke huqooq bache rahein.

Duniya bhar mein Europe ka General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) jaise dhaanche data ki hifazat aur privacy ke miyar tay karte hain. Bain-ul-aqwami AI ethics guidelines khud-kaar faislon (automated decision-making) mein transparency aur insaf ko farogh deti hain. Qaumi satah par mulk apni AI strategies bana rahe hain taake nayi ijaad zimmedari se ho. Pakistan bhi aise dhaanche apna kar yaqeeni bana sakta hai ke technology ki tarakki akhlaqi miyar ke mutabiq ho aur shehriyon ke mafadat mehfooz rahein.

Responsible innovation (zimmedarana ijaad) ka matlab sirf maali faide ke bajaye insani bhalai par dhyan dena hai. Technologies aisi banayi jayein jo zindagi ka miyar behtar karein, mauqe paida karein aur nuqsan kam karein. System banate waqt developers ko lambe arse ke samaji aur mahoolyati (environmental) asraat sochne chahiye, taake technology sab bastiyon ko barabar faida de.

blocks.title: Tidbit
blocks.text: Behtareen technologies logon ko pehle rakhti hain; akhlaqiyat aur hamdardi (empathy) nayi ijaad ke aham ajza hain.

Zimmedarana aur munsifana technology banane ke liye mukhtalif shobon ke maahireen ka mil kar kaam karna zaroori hai. Qanooni maahireen qawaid ki pabandi yaqeeni banate hain, sociologists (samajiyat ke maahireen) technology ka samaji asar parhte hain, aur ethicists (akhlaqiyat ke maahireen) akhlaqi faislon ki rehnumai karte hain. Mil kar yeh maahireen aise mutawazin hal banate hain jo logon ki hifazat bhi karein aur nayi ijaad ko bhi aage barhayein.

Technology ke hal un logon ke tanawwo ki numaindagi karein jin ki woh khidmat karte hain. Zaban, saqafat aur rasai (accessibility) ke farq ka khayal rakh kar developers aise systems bana sakte hain jo sirf chand logon ke liye nahi, sab ke liye kaam karein. Mukhtalif shobon ka ishtirak nayi ijaad ko sab ko shamil karne wala, munsifana aur paidar rakhta hai, aur aisi technology ki raah banata hai jo waqai muashre ko faida de.

blocks.prompt: Hospital ke AI project ko programmers ke saath qanooni maahir aur akhlaqiyat ka maahir kyun chahiye?
blocks.explanation: Qanooni maahir yaqeeni banata hai ke mareezon ka data data-protection qanoon aur ijazat ke saath jama aur mehfooz ho; akhlaqiyat ka maahir dekhta hai ke system tamam mareezon se munsifana sulook kare, us ke faisle samjhaye ja sakein, aur ghalti par kaun zimmedar ho. Akele programmers durusti par tawajjuh de kar yeh khatre nazar-andaz kar sakte hain.

items: Policies aur qawaneen (GDPR, AI ethics guidelines, qaumi AI strategy) mehfooz aur munsifana istemal ki rehnumai karte hain.
Zimmedarana ijaad: sirf munafa nahi, insani bhalai pehle.
Qanooni, samaji aur akhlaqi maahireen ka ishtirak technology ko sab ke liye munsifana banata hai.
